## FACT SHEET (M3b doc writers' source of truth)

### 1. Thread/actor inventory — bridge + driver v2
- **Bridge status tick** (engine side): not a separate thread — the engine's 100 ms control tick `tick()` at `crates/router-engine/src/engine.rs:1228`. Bridge section `engine.rs:1252-1274`: (a) detects negotiated-format change → engine restart ("bridge format changed to N Hz / M frames"); (b) `monitor.sample(...)` at `engine.rs:1260` feeding `BridgeMonitor` (`crates/router-engine/src/bridge.rs:200-245`) which derives `vbmatrix_running` from `driver_running` + `driver_beat` heartbeat each tick; (c) one `FillWindow` fill-dip sample per healthy tick (`bridge.rs:247-270`, 30 s window, `TICK` = 100 ms, `bridge.rs:57-59`); (d) builds `BridgeTick` with fill_a/fill_b/a_overruns/a_discarded/b_underruns/b_dropped (`engine.rs:1265-1273`); (e) applies `[bridge] ring_target_ms` as floor on ring-A target — live/hot (`engine.rs:1290`, `engine.rs:258`).
- **Loopback feeder**: dedicated non-RT thread named **`router-loopback`**, spawned by `spawn_loopback` (`bridge.rs:395-407`, name at :407). Drains the post-EQ tap into shm ring B with linear resampling and holds fill at `loopback_target_frames` (= two driver buffers + safety, `bridge.rs:343-346`). Spawn condition: bridge attached AND `[bridge] loopback_enabled` (`engine.rs:758`); stopped before engine teardown (`engine.rs:556`). Test: `bridge.rs:645`.
- **Driver pacing thread**: named **`eq-asio-pacing`** (`crates/eq-asio-driver/src/pacing.rs:183`). v2 bridge driver has no hardware, so this thread fires the host's `bufferSwitch(..., directProcess=TRUE)` callback (`lib.rs:7-10`, `driver.rs:10`, `driver.rs:338`): MMCSS `"Pro Audio"` (`pacing.rs:7`), waitable/period timer, QPC anchoring (`driver.rs:107,470`), re-anchors on rate change (`pacing.rs:274`), panics recovered (`pacing.rs:278`). Spawned from `start()` (`driver.rs:481-494`), joined at `stop()`/`disposeBuffers` with detach-if-called-from-callback semantics (`pacing.rs:192-233`, `driver.rs:514-544`).

### 2. Status block v3
- `STATUS_VERSION = 3`, v3 "grew to **192 bytes**" — `crates/eq-core/src/status.rs:11,13`; `size_of::<StatusBlock>() == 192` assert at `status.rs:79`.
- Bridge fields in order (`status.rs:56-75`): `bridge_attached` (offset 108, assert `status.rs:154`), `vbmatrix_running`, `bridge_sample_rate`, `bridge_buffer_frames`, `fill_a`, `fill_b`, `a_overruns`, `a_discarded`, `b_underruns`, `b_dropped` (offset 144, assert `status.rs:163`), then `_reserved: [u8;44]`. Validation: magic + version (`status.rs:127`).

### 3. `[bridge]` config semantics
- `BridgeConfig` `crates/eq-core/src/config.rs:126-152`: `ring_target_ms: f32` default **0.0**, `loopback_enabled: bool` default **true** (`config.rs:142`). `sanitized()` clamps `ring_target_ms` to **0..=200**, NaN→0 (`config.rs:147-151`).
- Live vs restart — `crates/router-engine/src/logic.rs:45-66` (`classify_change`): `loopback_enabled` change ⇒ `NeedsRestart("bridge loopback changed")` (`logic.rs:57-59`); `ring_target_ms` applied **live** — status tick re-derives the target (`logic.rs:60`, hot store `engine.rs:258`, floor applied `engine.rs:807,1290`). All other diffs ⇒ `HotApply`.
- Semantics: `ring_target_ms` = floor on the ring-A (source) fill target in ms at source rate, capped so the shm ring is safe (`bridge.rs:331`); `loopback_enabled` gates creation/teardown of the `router-loopback` feeder (`engine.rs:758`).

### 4. Removed keys + deprecation notice
- `REMOVED_CONFIG_KEYS` (`config.rs:33-44`): `capture_device`, `capture_mode`, `capture_period_ms`, `render_keepalive`, `keepalive`, `match_cable_rate`, `cable_rate_match`, `source_preset`, `source`.
- Exact notice wording (`config.rs:92-94`): `config: removed setting(s) ignored: {keys joined ", "} — since M3a the audio source is the VBMatrix bridge; delete these keys from the file`. One-shot per process (`DEPRECATION_TAKEN` `config.rs:46-49`, `take_deprecation_notice` :84). Consumers: `router-cli/src/main.rs:393`, `router-engine/src/engine.rs:1195`, `router-core/src/watcher.rs:106`, `eq-asio-app/src/app.rs:120,403`.

### 5. router-cli flag surface (post-cutover)
- Subcommands: `devices`, `caps`, `holders`, `analyze`, `latency`, `run`, `--help` (`main.rs:37-59`, enum `main.rs:67-79`). **There is no `impulses` subcommand in router-cli** — "impulses" only exists as `capture-probe impulses` in `crates/wasapi-capture/src/bin/capture_probe.rs:514` (doc writers should not document a router-cli impulses command).
- `RUN_FLAGS` (`main.rs:91-104`): `--config --seconds --forever --master --rate --safety-ms --preamp-db --bypass --learn --dump-dir --synthetic --synthetic-db`.
- `LATENCY_FLAGS` (`main.rs:105-136`): `--sink --count --interval-ms --db --config --allow-sink --shape --hp-hz --json --cap-threshold-db --lb-threshold-db --baseline --selftest --seconds --dump --no-save --save --render-mode --render-buffer-frames --render-fill --render-prefill --master --rate --safety-ms --preamp-db --bypass`.
- `MASTER_FLAGS = [--master]`, `ANALYZE_FLAGS = [--freq --skip --tail --channel --mads]` (`main.rs:137-139`).
- Rejected (unknown flag ⇒ exit 2 before engine start, `main.rs:7,154`): `--source --capture --period-ms --keepalive --no-keepalive --mode --no-match-cable` — asserted by test `removed_capture_flags_are_rejected` `main.rs:622-641` (both `run` and `latency`).

### 6. latency/impulses behavior
- Allowed sinks: `is_sink_allowed` (`crates/wasapi-capture/src/impulse.rs:160-166`) = known virtual-cable names (Hi-Fi Cable Input, Line 1 VAC — tests :795-796) **or** `is_vbmatrix_render_name` (`impulse.rs:151-155`, matches `"VBMatrix In 1"`, `"VBMatrix In 3 (VB-Audio Matrix VAIO)"`, case-insensitive) **or** explicit `--allow-sink` allow-list. Only the In side counts (`VBMatrix Out 1` rejected, :799).
- `BRIDGE_SOURCE_KEY = "vbmatrix"` (`crates/eq-core/src/config.rs:28`); session entry key = `source=vbmatrix` (`measured.rs:96,106`, tests `measured.rs:309-316`).
- Stage 1 = ring-A tap: click injected into VBMatrix render endpoint (`VBMatrix In *`), detected first at bridge source side = stage 1 ring-A tap, stage 2 at Yamaha loopback inputs (USAGE `router-cli/src/main.rs:47-52`; measured fields `capture_to_bridge_ms` "arrival on bridge source side (ring-A tap)" `measured.rs:114`, `capture_to_tap_ms` :116-117). Latency banner: `router-cli/src/latency.rs:201`.

### 7. Crates + test suites
- 11 crates: `asio-abi`, `asio-host`, `asio-probe`, `bridge-abi`, `eq-asio-app`, `eq-asio-driver`, `eq-core`, `router-cli`, `router-core`, `router-engine`, `wasapi-capture`.
- `bridge-abi` = shared-memory contract for the v2 bridge: mapping `Local\eq_asio_router_bridge_v2`, Header 0-4096, ring A 4096-135168 (driver→app source), ring B 135168-266240 (app→driver loopback) (`bridge-abi/src/lib.rs:1-20`).
- `eq-asio-driver` = v2 bridge DLL loaded by the ASIO host (VBMatrix), registered as **"EQ ASIO Router"**; it is the engine's source/loopback peer via shm, not a WASAPI capture path.
- Test suites: **25** per gate report at 0728f2c (dependency/assess output; I did not re-run `cargo test` — read-only). Structure verified: 3 integration files (`eq-asio-driver/tests/com_smoke.rs`, `eq-core/tests/jbl_audit.rs`, `router-core/tests/stream_integrity.rs`) + `#[cfg(test)]` in 10 of 11 crates (asio-probe has none).

### 8. eq-asio-app "EQ ASIO Router" occurrences
**(A) Display strings the Headroom rebrand MAY change:**
- `main.rs:1` doc comment "EQ ASIO Router GUI." (doc, safe)
- `main.rs:69` `.with_title("EQ ASIO Router")` — window title
- `main.rs:82` `eframe::run_native("EQ ASIO Router", ...)` — app name; display in eframe but verify no test/logic depends (none found)
- `app.rs:471` `ui.heading("EQ ASIO Router")`
- `tray.rs:152-154` tooltip base `format!("EQ ASIO Router \u{2014} {label}")`
- `cli.rs:4` usage text `EQ ASIO Router (GUI)`
- Tests: `tray.rs:636-641` (`tooltip_text`) asserts `"EQ ASIO Router — Running (48000 Hz, 30.2 ms est.)"` and `"EQ ASIO Router — Stopped"` → must be updated together with :154.

**(B) Frozen — MUST NOT change:**
- `autostart.rs:24` `VALUE_NAME: &str = "EQ ASIO Router"` (registry value) + test `autostart.rs:261`
- `app.rs:197` device filter `n != "EQ ASIO Router"` (ASIO device name)
- `panels/bridge.rs:44` `asio_host::find_driver("EQ ASIO Router")` and `:71` `"EQ ASIO Router" registered/not registered` (matches registered driver name)
- Tray window class `"EqAsioRouterTrayWindow"` (`tray.rs:547`) — frozen; hidden window title `"EQ ASIO Router tray"` (`tray.rs:561`, lpWindowName of a never-shown window) — display-only, low-risk, prefer leaving it.

**Tests asserting display strings:** only `tray.rs:638,640` (rebrandable) and `autostart.rs:261` (frozen). No test asserts the window title, heading, or cli.rs usage text.

**Recommended Headroom strings:**
- Window title (`main.rs:69`): `Headroom` (optionally `main.rs:82` app name too)
- Tray tooltip (`tray.rs:154`): `Headroom — <label>`; update tests `tray.rs:638` → `"Headroom \u{2014} Running (48000 Hz, 30.2 ms est.)"`, `:640` → `"Headroom \u{2014} Stopped"`
- Heading `app.rs:471`: `Headroom`; cli.rs:4 usage: `Headroom (GUI)`
- Tagline (`docs/plans/naming-decision.md:6-7`): *"System-wide parametric EQ at the lowest latency your hardware allows."*
- In-scope list: `naming-decision.md:11-15`; out-of-scope (binaries, crates, `"EQ ASIO Router"` ASIO name/CLSID/registry, `Local\eq_asio_router_status`, log/config paths): `naming-decision.md:17-25` — whole file is only 25 lines.
